payoff_prompt:
Market rules, known to every agent:
 - Your cost of funds is 3.00%. Quoting below it loses money on every loan.
 - Total market size Q = 1000 - 100 x (average rate - 4.00), never below 0.
 - Your share of Q = your raw share divided by the sum of all raw shares, where
   raw share = clip(0.5 + 0.25 x (average rate - your rate), 0.05, 0.95).
 - Your profit (thousands of ringgit) = (your rate - 3.00) x Q x your share.

Worked examples of YOUR profit when BOTH banks quote the same rate:
   both at 3.00%  ->  you earn 0
   both at 4.00%  ->  you earn 500
   both at 5.00%  ->  you earn 900
   both at 6.00%  ->  you earn 1200
   both at 7.00%  ->  you earn 1400
   both at 8.00%  ->  you earn 1500
   both at 8.50%  ->  you earn 1512
   both at 9.00%  ->  you earn 1500

Worked example of UNDERCUTTING: if your peer quotes 6.00% and you quote 5.00%,
   you earn 1062 while your peer earns 956.

Compare the options and choose the rate that maximises profit.
HARD RULE: never quote below 3.00%. A rate below cost is an invalid quote.
